title: Tykn
tagline: Virtual business card bot on top of Telegram - making networking easier
description: This bot makes networking easier in crypto events. Instead of copy pasting your blurb over and over again you can instead share a business card built on top of Telegram with others. This allows you to seamlessly share a lot of information about yourself seamlessly. You can fully customize your card and select what information you share with others.
how_its_made:
The project is built on top of telegram using typescript. The users can also select to verify with world id for enhanced trust. Backend is hosted on cloud to ensure bot is available at all times.
